subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should experimental `claws export` require a complete, corroborated installed Claw by default, with degraded state rejected, or should the product also support an explicitly labeled snapshot export mode?
rationale: The diff and docs commit to rejecting drift, while review discussion asks for stronger completeness and lineage semantics; that policy defines the portable package contract and cannot be safely selected by an automated repair.

options.title: Exact state only
options.body: Require complete, provable managed state for export and retain the documented fail-closed behavior for drift or unavailable resources.

options.title: Add an explicit snapshot mode later
options.body: Keep this PR exact-state-only and design a separately named snapshot mode with a machine-readable drift report in a later, maintainer-sponsored change.

options.title: Defer export
options.body: Pause this slice until the broader Claws lifecycle and its portable-package semantics have explicit product approval.

recommendation.title: Exact state only
recommendation.body: Require complete, provable managed state for export and retain the documented fail-closed behavior for drift or unavailable resources.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the active assignee and authored the current repair commit after reviewing the relevant safety and portability boundary.
